# ComputeIQ Tech — Accessories & Peripherals

This document details the charging solutions, hubs, and protective gear available at ComputeIQ Tech (New York, NY).

---

## 1. NovaCharge 65W GaN Fast Charger

- **Product Category**: Chargers & Power Adapters
- **Model Number**: NC-65-GAN
- **Price**: LKR 4,500 (Approx. $15 USD)
- **Warranty**: 3-Month Hassle-Free Replacement Warranty

### Key Features & Specifications
- **Technology**: Advanced Gallium Nitride (GaN III) semiconductor technology, generating 40% less heat while occupying 50% less physical volume than standard silicon chargers.
- **Total Power Output**: 65W Max.
- **Port Configuration**:
  - **USB-C1**: Up to 65W (PD 3.0, PPS 3.3V-11V/5A, QC 4.0+)
  - **USB-C2**: Up to 30W (PD 3.0)
  - **USB-A**: Up to 18W (QC 3.0 / SCP / FCP)
- **Multi-Port Intelligent Power Distribution**:
  - C1 + C2 simultaneous: 45W + 20W (charges laptop and phone together)
  - C1 + A simultaneous: 45W + 18W
  - C1 + C2 + A simultaneous: 45W + 10W + 10W
- **Compatibility**:
  - Laptops: NovaBook Air, MacBook Air/Pro, Dell XPS 13, ThinkPad X1, HP Spectre.
  - Phones & Tablets: iPhone 12–16 series, Samsung Galaxy S21–S25 series, Google Pixel, iPad Pro/Air.
  - Gaming & Consoles: Nintendo Switch, Steam Deck.
- **Safety Protection Suite**: Active temperature monitoring, over-current, over-voltage, short-circuit, and electrostatic discharge protection.
- **Included in Box**: 1.5m braided 100W E-marker USB-C to USB-C cable and foldable US plug prongs.

# ComputeIQ Tech — Audio Products

This document covers wireless audio gear and headphones available at ComputeIQ Tech (New York, NY).

---

## 1. NovaBuds True Wireless Earbuds

- **Product Category**: Audio & Wearables
- **Model Number**: NB-500-TWS
- **Price**: LKR 12,500 (Approx. $42 USD)
- **Warranty**: 6-Month Limited Warranty
- **Available Colors**: Arctic White, Matte Obsidian, Sky Blue

### Sound & Acoustic Performance
- **Drivers**: 11mm custom dynamic drivers engineered with rigid ultra-thin graphene diaphragms for punchy bass and crystalline highs.
- **Frequency Response**: 20 Hz – 20,000 Hz.
- **Audio Codecs**: AAC and SBC supported over high-bandwidth Bluetooth.
- **Sound Profile**: Tuned for balanced studio clarity, with customizable EQ presets available via quick tap sequences.

### Noise Cancellation & Ambient Modes
- **Hybrid Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)**: Dual internal and external microphones suppress up to 38dB of low-frequency ambient environmental noise (airplane cabin roar, subway rumble, office chatter).
- **Transparency Mode**: One-touch pass-through mode channels external human voices and ambient sound so you can cross city streets or converse without removing the earbuds.

### Battery & Charging
- **Earbud Playback Time**:
  - Up to 7 hours of continuous listening (ANC OFF).
  - Up to 6 hours of continuous listening (ANC ON).
- **Total Playback with Charging Case**: Up to 30 hours total.
- **Quick Charge Feature**: 10 minutes in the charging case provides 2 full hours of listening time.
- **Case Charging Interface**: USB-C fast charging port (charging cable included) and Qi wireless charging pad compatibility.

### Connectivity & Smart Features
- **Bluetooth Version**: Bluetooth 5.4 with low-latency gaming mode (sub-60ms delay).
- **Bluetooth Multipoint**: Connects to 2 devices simultaneously (e.g., laptop and smartphone) with automatic audio switching.
- **Call Quality**: 4 environmental beamforming microphones equipped with AI deep neural network (DNN) wind-noise reduction.
- **Water & Sweat Resistance**: IPX5 rating (sweatproof for intense workouts, running, and light rain).
- **Touch Controls**: Capacitive sensor on both stems for play/pause, track skip, volume control, ANC toggle, and Siri/Google Assistant activation.

# ComputeIQ Tech — Laptop Catalog

# ComputeIQ Tech — Payment Options & Financing

ComputeIQ Tech offers multiple secure, fast, and flexible payment methods for both online orders and in-store purchases at our Manhattan showroom.

---

## 1. Supported Payment Methods

### Credit & Debit Cards
We accept all major international and domestic cards:
- **Visa** (Credit & Debit)
- **MasterCard** (Credit & Debit)
- **American Express** (Amex)
- **Discover**
- **JCB** & **UnionPay**

### Digital Wallets & Contactless Pay
- **Apple Pay**: Supported on web (Safari/iOS) and via NFC terminals in-store.
- **Google Pay**: Supported on Chrome/Android and in-store tap-to-pay.
- **PayPal**: Available for instant checkout on online purchases.

### Direct Bank Transfers (ACH / Wire)
- Accepted for corporate, educational, and high-volume wholesale orders above $1,000 USD (or LKR 300,000).
- Invoices include official routing/SWIFT information with payment terms net-15 or net-30 upon credit approval.

### In-Store Counter Payments
- **Cash**: Accepted in USD at our Manhattan showroom counter.
- **Chip & PIN / NFC Contactless**: Supported on all registered debit and credit cards.

---

## 2. Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) & Financing Plans

ComputeIQ Tech partners with leading consumer financing providers to offer flexible monthly payment installments:

| Provider | Available Plans | Interest Rate | Minimum Order |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Klarna** | Pay in 4 equal bi-weekly payments | **0% APR** | $50 USD |
| **Affirm** | 3, 6, or 12 monthly installments | 0%–15% APR (credit dependent) | $150 USD |
| **Afterpay** | 4 equal interest-free installments | **0% APR** | $35 USD |

*Example for NovaBook Air ($620 USD): Pay 4 interest-free installments of $155 every two weeks via Klarna.*

---

## 3. Cryptocurrencies & Unaccepted Methods

- **Cryptocurrencies**: We currently **do not accept** Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, or other cryptocurrencies.
- **Personal Paper Checks**: We do not accept personal checks by mail or in-store. Cashier's checks and verified business corporate checks are accepted with prior manager authorization.

---

## 4. Payment Security & Encryption

- **PCI-DSS Level 1 Compliant**: All online transactions are processed through end-to-end tokenized payment gateways.
- **256-Bit SSL Encryption**: Every transaction is protected with military-grade TLS 1.3 encryption.
- **Zero Card Storage**: ComputeIQ Tech never stores raw credit card numbers, CVVs, or debit PIN codes on our servers or databases.

# ComputeIQ Tech — Product Warranties & Service Terms

ComputeIQ Tech stands behind all hardware sold with official manufacturer warranties, verified repair service, and customer protection guarantees.

---

## 1. Warranty Periods by Product Category

| Product Category | Example Products | Warranty Duration | Service Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Laptops & Workstations** | NovaBook Air, NovaBook Pro | **2 Years** (24 Months) | Parts & Labor / Hardware Repair |
| **Audio Products** | NovaBuds True Wireless | **6 Months** | Repair or Unit Replacement |
| **Chargers & Power Adapters** | NovaCharge 65W GaN | **3 Months** | Direct Over-The-Counter Replacement |
| **Docks & Hubs** | NovaDock Ultra 8-in-1 | **1 Year** (12 Months) | Repair or Replacement |
| **Cables & Sleeves** | NovaSleeve, Charging Cables | **30 Days** | Defect Replacement |

---

## 2. What Is Covered Under Warranty

The warranty covers internal hardware malfunctions, component failures, and manufacturing defects occurring under normal, intended use:
- Motherboard and processor failures.
- Factory screen defects (including display flickering, line artifacts, and more than 3 dead pixels).
- Internal battery failures (e.g., failure to retain charge or battery health degrading below 80% within warranty period).
- Non-functional keyboards, touchpads, and factory port failures.
- Charger power delivery malfunction or internal component burnout.
- NovaBuds charging case failure or audio driver loss of output under normal volume levels.

---

## 3. What Is NOT Covered (Exclusions)

The warranty does not cover issues resulting from external hazards, customer accidents, or misuse:
1. **Accidental Physical Damage**: Cracked screens, dented chassis, broken hinges, drops, or crushed casing.
2. **Liquid Damage**: Spillages, submersion, immersion, or corrosion caused by liquids.
3. **Unauthorized Modification**: Products opened, serviced, or repaired by unauthorized third-party technicians.
4. **Cosmetic Wear and Tear**: Scratches, cosmetic fading, paint peeling, or minor scuffs that do not affect device functionality.
5. **Software & Malware**: Operating system corruption, third-party software incompatibilities, malware, or ransomware.
6. **Serial Number Tampering**: Removal, defacing, or alteration of the original serial number sticker.

---

## 4. Optional Extended Coverage: ComputeIQ Care+

Customers purchasing any NovaBook laptop can enroll in **ComputeIQ Care+** at checkout or within 30 days of purchase:
- **Price**: $49 USD (LKR 14,500).
- **Benefits**:
  - Adds 1 additional year of hardware warranty (total 3 years).
  - Includes 1 incident of accidental damage protection (screen drop or liquid spill) with a flat $35 repair deductible.
  - Priority queue at the Manhattan repair lounge.

---

## 5. How to Submit a Warranty Claim

1. **In-Person**: Visit the ComputeIQ Tech Manhattan Showroom & Service Lounge (450 Lexington Ave, Suite 1200, New York, NY) with the product and original purchase receipt or email confirmation.
2. **Online RMA (Mail-in)**:
   - Email **support@computeiq.tech** with the subject `Warranty Claim - [Order Number]`.
   - Provide a description of the defect and a short video or photograph illustrating the issue.
   - If approved, ComputeIQ Tech issues a prepaid return shipping label.
   - Standard turnaround time for diagnostic inspection and repair is 3 to 5 business days.

# ComputeIQ Tech — Return & Refund Policy

At ComputeIQ Tech, customer satisfaction is our top priority. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, review our transparent return and refund policies below.

---

## 1. 7-Day Standard Return Window

Customers have **7 calendar days** from the date of physical delivery (or in-store purchase) to initiate a return for an exchange or full refund.

### Return Conditions
To qualify for a full refund or exchange:
1. **Pristine Condition**: The item must be unused, undamaged, and free from any cosmetic scratches, marks, or personal data.
2. **Complete Original Packaging**: The product must be returned with its original manufacturer box, intact serial number barcodes, foam inserts, manuals, power adapters, and bundled cables.
3. **Proof of Purchase**: The customer must present the physical register receipt, invoice, or online order confirmation number.

---

## 2. Non-Returnable & Hygiene-Restricted Items

Due to hygiene, safety, and health regulations:
- **NovaBuds Earbuds (In-Ear)**: Once the sanitary factory box seal has been broken or opened, NovaBuds **cannot be returned for a refund**, unless the unit is verified to be DOA (Dead On Arrival) or has a verified hardware defect.
- **Gift Cards & Software**: Downloadable software licenses, digital redemption codes, and ComputeIQ gift cards are strictly non-refundable.
- **Clearance Items**: Any items marked as "Final Sale" or "Clearance" cannot be returned.

---

## 3. Damaged in Transit or Defective Upon Arrival (DOA)

- If your parcel arrives visibly crushed, opened, or if the product does not power on right out of the box, you must report it within **48 hours of delivery**.
- Send photos of the shipping box, product packaging, and defect to **support@computeiq.tech**.
- ComputeIQ Tech will immediately dispatch a replacement unit and issue a prepaid courier pickup label at zero expense to you.

---

## 4. Restocking Fees

- **Zero Restocking Fee**: Unopened, sealed items returned within 7 days incur **no restocking fee**.
- **15% Open-Box Fee**: If a laptop (NovaBook Air / Pro) has been opened, booted, and tested, but is in immaculate physical condition with all accessories, a 15% open-box restocking fee applies to cover hardware sanitization and testing.

---

## 5. Refund Processing Times

- Once your return arrives at our Manhattan facility, our technical team completes inspection within **2 business days**.
- Approved refunds are credited directly to the original payment method:
  - **Credit/Debit Cards**: 3 to 5 business days (depending on your issuing bank).
  - **Apple Pay / Google Pay**: 1 to 3 business days.
  - **In-Store Cash Purchases**: Instant cash or original debit card refund at the counter.
